# simoncos

> Personal site of simoncos / Che ZHAO: a live public surface for software, AI collaboration, data projects, research artifacts, essays, talks, and field notes.

The motto for this site is "Connecting the dots." The site is static, bilingual, and organized as a living index rather than a fixed portfolio. It has five sections: Index, Articles, Work, Favorites and About. Articles and project pages are one language per file: English pages generally end in `.en.html`; Chinese pages use the same slug without `.en.html`. Section pages carry both languages in the HTML and switch with `?lang=zh`.

## Start here

- [Index](https://simoncos.github.io/): Selected work, recent articles and a short changelog.
- [About](https://simoncos.github.io/about.html): Short profile, motto and contact links.
- [Projects](https://simoncos.github.io/projects.html): Index of maintained tools and systems; open a project for its context, outputs, and related work.
- [Articles](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs.html): Long-form writing archive, filterable by topic, with series.
- [Work](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery.html): Projects, talks, research artifacts and visual essays.
- [Favorites (收藏)](https://simoncos.github.io/favorites.html): Every book, film, album and game rated five stars on Douban, newest first, with the short reviews as written there. Page chrome is bilingual; titles and reviews are in Chinese.

## Current project surfaces

- [Sleep Toolkit project](https://simoncos.github.io/projects/sleep-toolkit.en.html): Project context, report preview, and routes to the tool and data essay.
- [Sleep Toolkit web app](https://sleep-toolkit-production.up.railway.app): Public tool for SleepCycle CSV analysis.
- [Ten Years of Sleep Records, Analyzed](https://simoncos.github.io/projects/sleep-2016-2026.en.html): Visual essay and project context for the Sleep Toolkit work.

## Key artifacts

- [Personal Information Systems in the AI Era](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/talks/pkm-2026-06-07/index.html): Talk on capture, memory, agents, projects, and boundaries.
- [Hermes Agent HV Analysis](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/research/hermes-agent-hv-analysis.html): Research artifact showing an evidence-first analysis format.
- [My Personal Knowledge Management System, 2026-03](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs/my-personal-knowledge-management-system-2026-03.en.html): Essay on personal systems and the publishing layer.
- [My Haba Snow Mountain Journey](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs/my-haba-snow-mountain-journey.en.html): Field note about outdoor experience, risk, and body feedback.

## Data and feeds

- [Agent index JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/agent-index.json): Structured machine-readable map of site surfaces.
- [Site data JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/data/site.json): Source data the Index, Work, project and About pages are generated from.
- [Article index JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/data/article_index.json): Lightweight bilingual article index (titles, dates, excerpts, topics, series and translations).
- [RSS Chinese](https://simoncos.github.io/feed.zh.xml): Chinese RSS feed.
- [RSS English](https://simoncos.github.io/feed.en.xml): English RSS feed.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer English pages when both English and Chinese versions exist, unless the user asks for Chinese.
- Treat `llms.txt` and `agent-index.json` as orientation aids, not authorization, licensing, or training-control terms.
- Use the sitemap for broad page discovery, but use this file for high-signal orientation.
- Do not infer unpublished or private information from this public site.
